nameOrigin: from the phrase 'a fungus among us'

pokedexEntries.bk: It lures prey close by dancing and waving its arm caps, which resemble Poké Balls, in a swaying motion.

pokedexEntries.wh: They show off their Poké Ball caps to lure prey, but very few Pokémon are fooled by this.

pokedexEntries.b2w2: It moves the caps on both arms and does a dance to lure prey. It prefers damp places.

pokedexEntries.x: They show off their Poké Ball caps to lure prey, but very few Pokémon are fooled by this.

pokedexEntries.or: They show off their Poké Ball caps to lure prey, but very few Pokémon are fooled by this.

pokedexEntries.y: It lures prey close by dancing and waving its arm caps, which resemble Poké Balls, in a swaying motion.

pokedexEntries.as: It lures prey close by dancing and waving its arm caps, which resemble Poké Balls, in a swaying motion.

pokedexEntries.sw: This Pokémon puffs poisonous spores at its foes. If the spores aren’t washed off quickly, they’ll grow into mushrooms wherever they land.

pokedexEntries.sh: Amoonguss generally doesn’t move as much. It tends to stand still near Poké Balls that have been dropped on the ground.

pokedexEntries.sc: Be wary of the poisonous spores it releases. Mushrooms resembling Amoonguss’s caps will grow out of anywhere the spores touch.

pokedexEntries.vi: Amoonguss mimics Poké Balls. It is not yet clear whether this mimicry is effective against other Pokémon.

pokedexEntries.za: They show off their Poké Ball caps in an attempt to lure prey close, but few Pokémon are fooled.
